title: Atom Simulation
desc: An experimental GPU-powered atom simulation where thousands or even millions of atoms move, interact, and form different structures!

Watch atoms constantly move around, interact with one another, and create different arrangements through simulated bonding behavior. See how simple atomic interactions can produce increasingly complex structures.
Multiple element types with individual colors.
This project is still actively being developed. More elements, advanced chemistry, realistic bonding, temperature, material states, and molecular recognition are planned for future updates.
Note: This is an experimental chemistry simulation, not a fully scientifically accurate molecular dynamics engine. Some interactions and bonding behaviors are simplified.
(note this is made with AI so bugs can happen)
